Get Your Bread As Fast As You Can.
If you know my story, you know I believe in that shit. I did almost $250K my first year in Christmas lights, and I’ve been obsessed with growing this business ever since.
Now I want to give some of that back.
I announced I was starting a podcast for the Christmas light industry, and apparently I don’t know how to do anything halfway. I’ve already got close to 20 episodes lined up before the first episode has even dropped… and I’m still booking more.
This isn’t a funnel. I don’t have anything to sell you.
I want this to be a neutral platform for the entire Christmas light industry. Installers, business owners, suppliers, manufacturers, industry experts, marketers, and the guys actually out there doing the work.
Big companies. Small companies. Different perspectives. Different ways of doing things.
Just real conversations, talking shop, learning from each other, and giving value back to the industry.
The Gingerbread Podcast is officially here.
Let’s get this bread.

author: The Green Institute
description:
If you want to change the world, you need to understand it. And to understand it, you need the right tools.
Welcome to Praxis, a podcast on understanding the economy and how it dominates our lives, hosted by Max Chandler-Mather and Bec Sparks from The Green Institute.
Too often the world of economics is dictated entirely by a small elite group of economists, experts and institutions, telling the same old convenient story: that the way things are, are the way they’ve gotta be.
Everything from the wage you’re paid, to the cooking and cleaning you do at home, and the debit card in your pocket, are all defined by the same economic and political forces that drive capitalism. In this limited series, you’ll hear from experts across the country tackling the biggest questions and giving you the tools to critique common economic stories and apply an economic lens to politics.

Whether retirement is approaching or you’re already navigating life after a paycheck, listen for practical questions to ask and a clearer understanding of your options.

description:
Welcome to MrYouWho – Real Products, Real Tests, Real Reviews, hosted by Andrew Hough.

Discover what technology, products and software are really like before you spend your money.

From headphones, speakers and home entertainment to AI software, smart home technology, robotic cleaners, solar power systems and the latest gadgets, we put products and software to the test in real-world conditions.

With hundreds of hands-on reviews and comparisons across the MrYouWho Media Network, we go beyond manufacturer specifications and marketing claims to explore how products actually perform, what works, what doesn’t and whether they’re worth buying.

Expect detailed product reviews, head-to-head comparisons, practical demonstrations, long-term testing and straightforward buying advice.

Real products. Real tests. Real reviews.

Hosted by Andrew Hough | MrYouWho Media Group

title: VR Barnes
author: Violet Rebecca
description:
Violet Rebecca Barnes

Science fiction promised us flying cars, silver jumpsuits, and dinner in a pill—and honestly, none of that sounded very comfortable anyway. Welcome to VR Barnes, where host Violet Rebecca Barnes skips the gloomy robot-apocalypse stories to look at the genuinely good, helpful, and wonderfully human things tomorrow is bringing into our lives. From clever home helpers that let our grandparents stay in their own kitchens, and medicine that actually knows your name, to quieter streets, fixable toasters, and ways to keep your brain calm in a world full of screens, this is your cheerful guide to the decades ahead. Grab a cup of coffee, leave the doom-scrolling at the door, and let us talk about why the future is looking a lot brighter—and much more livable—than the movies told us.

title: The Closing Table
author: Jared Nicolaisen and Bobby Ray Bunch
description:
Bobby and Jared met each other at a real estate conference and quickly hit it off - because why not, we created a podcast.

With a real estate background, that will be the basis of most of our conversations. There will be humor, advice, encouragement, and overall info about our lives.

Join us in our fun convos and let's go on a ride.

title: Science. Soul. Spark.
author: Kylie Moffitt
description:
Healthcare doesn't have to sound clinical. It can be evidence-based and entertaining. Professional and playful. Educational and deeply human.


Science. Soul. Spark. brings together the personalities, expertise, curiosity and chemistry of the PhysioHealth and CanConquer team to have real conversations about health, longevity, cancer, movement and life.

Know more. Feel more. Do more!

title: Expedition Healthspan
author: Ryan McNally
description: Living longer is only half the battle — the real goal is thriving for as long as possible. Expedition Healthspan is a conversation from the frontier of longevity: what the research actually says about exercise, sleep, food, hormones, and the biology of aging, explained in plain English by clinician Ryan McNally, ND, PA, who goes straight to the researchers and clinicians producing that research — and translates dense clinical science into everyday habits. Short, digestible episodes built for real life — no hype, no product pitches, just the science and what to do with it. Your journey starts here.

title: 3T THE PODCAST
author: Alphonso
description:
3T THE PODCAST is a survivor-led space built for truth, healing, and real-life transformation. Hosted by Alphonso Pelt alongside co-host Storm, 3T creates a judgment-free environment where survivors of childhood abuse and trauma can feel seen, understood, and supported without being talked down to or treated like a case study. Each episode blends structured, practical insight with raw, honest conversation—because healing is not a performance, it is a process, and nobody should have to do it alone.

At its core, 3T THE PODCAST exists to help people move from surviving to rebuilding with clarity, boundaries, and self-respect. We talk about trauma responses, family dynamics, recovery tools, and the long-term impact of abuse across every stage of life, while keeping the message grounded and actionable for both survivors and the people who love them. This is your reminder that self-care is not selfish, community matters, and liberation is possible—one honest step at a time.

title: Search Takeover™ | Dominate Your Information Environment
author: Andrew Hough
description:
Search Takeover™ explores how businesses, brands and individuals can become the dominant source of information within their Information Environment.

Created by Andrew Hough, founder of the MrYouWho Media Network, Search Takeover is built on seven years of real-world experience producing technology reviews, building an international media network and repeatedly achieving information dominance across Google Search, YouTube, video, Shorts and AI-powered search.

We explore how information influences what people discover, who they trust and ultimately who they choose. Through real case studies, practical strategies and original research, we examine how businesses can dominate the information surrounding their products, services, competitors, names and even ideas.

From search engines and artificial intelligence to digital media and content distribution, discover what it takes to build, influence and dominate an Information Environment.

Search Takeover™ — Dominate Your Information Environment.

title: Modern Human
author: George Westlake
description:
Modern life gives us more choice, comfort and opportunity than ever before. But is it actually making us happier?
Modern Human is a podcast exploring what it means to live well in the modern world.
Through open, honest conversations with people from all walks of life, we explore the big questions around happiness, purpose, relationships, work, identity and what it means to be human.
No blueprints, perfect answers or five-step formulas. Just curiosity, different perspectives and a willingness to question what we've been taught about success and living a good life.

description: From your feed and self-proclaimed internet historian, welcome to Oh my Kosh by Hannah Kosh. Every week, join Hannah as she sifts through the endless scroll to bring you the real stories behind the headlines. From tracking micro-trend lifespans and influencer feuds to dissecting surprise album drops, parasocial relationships, and the latest movie premieres, Oh my Kosh treats internet culture with the journalistic integrity (and absolute absurdity) it deserves. The Brave List is weekly conversations with leaders, dreamers, creatives, influential people and everyday legends about the moment they followed the thing that lit them up, before they had any proof it would work. Their story about starting. The fears, the hurdles, and the moment they went for it anyway.
These are thought provoking, honest conversations about courage and creating your dream life. You will hear how ordinary people talked themselves into extraordinary decisions.
Hosted by Steph Gabriel, founder, speaker and expeditioner who takes women on life changing bucket list adventures to some of the most extraordinary parts of the planet.
If you have got something you keep almost starting, this show is your nudge.
Come for the stories. Leave with the guts to write your own.

Researchers Jason Kostrna and Ekaterina Oparina join artist and producer Heather Kostrna to unpack research in plain language, then invite the people behind the work to tell us what we got right, wrong, or missed. Expect expert guests, unexpected detours, laughter, humility, and three people who genuinely love each other. Come curious. You don't have to have it figured out.

author: OWASP GenAI Security Project
description: The GenAI Security Inside Track goes inside the OWASP GenAI Security Project — the global, community-driven initiative behind the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the Agent Control Standard, and the frameworks securing generative and agentic AI. Hosted by Scott Clinton, Chair and Co-Founder of the project, each episode features the contributors and sponsor organizations putting this work into practice — from LLM Top 10 to agentic security, threat intelligence, governance, and red teaming.

title: The Unspoken Cost of Cancer Podcast
author: Brett Wilson
description:
Cancer’s costs reach far beyond the medical bills.
The Unspoken Cost Podcast, hosted by Brett Wilson, founder and CEO of Walking Miracles Family Foundation and a two-time childhood cancer survivor, brings those often-overlooked burdens into the conversation.
From travel expenses and missed work to emotional exhaustion, strained relationships, and the lasting effects of treatment, this podcast explores what cancer means for patients, survivors, caregivers, and families—during treatment and long afterward.

title: Prey Tell
author: Ashley Schef
description:
PREY TELL is a true crime podcast built with the belief that the victim is the story, not the sensationalized predator. Every victim has a story to tell, and that story deserves to be told. The naming of Prey Tell is a nod to the victims. Calling someone prey is what victims are reduced to when our society and legal system labels them as a case number and neglects to remember the real human suffering. My intention is to help reclaim that word for every victim. Because in every episode, I’ll examine a case and hunt for the truth.

 

New episodes drop every week. You can subscribe now wherever you get your podcasts, and find the show across social media platforms @preytellpodcast.

title: Not So Ancient History
author: Natasha Billson & Emily Harriss
description:
History is stranger than you think! Join archaeologists and history creators Natasha Billson and Emily Harriss as they dig into the weird, wonderful and sometimes downright disturbing stories of the past.
Not So Ancient History explores the history you probably didn't learn at school. Expect fascinating discoveries, historical mysteries, a little myth-busting and plenty of laughs along the way.
Because the past is never quite what it seems.
Your hosts: 
Emily Harriss — @emilyexpeditions
Natasha Billson — @tash_archaeo | Behind the Trowel
Follow the podcast: @nsahistory

description:
The towing industry deserves an honest conversation. The Towing Standard with Jeff Poquette delivers it.
After six and a half years co-hosting The Tow Business Podcast, Jeff takes the microphone solo to bring an owner's perspective to the issues shaping towing and recovery. From business practices and industry politics to safety, leadership, and the realities of running trucks, he challenges conventional thinking and asks the questions worth answering.
Expect candid opinions, practical experience, and a willingness to question the way things have always been done. Industry politics may be part of the conversation, but they don't set the agenda.
For the people doing the work, running the businesses, and expecting better from their industry—this is The Towing Standard.

description:
Leadership advice is everywhere. Evidence is harder to find. Subject to Evidence cuts through the noise to explore what actually works in leading organisations, from setting strategy to running meetings that matter.

Each season takes one big question about leadership and management and works through it episode by episode, drawing on research, real-world practice and hard-won lessons. Season 1 explores strategic leadership: what it is, why it so often fails, and how leaders can do it well. Season 2 tackles meetings, from everyday catch-ups to the strategic sessions that shape an organisation’s future.

Made for executives, managers, board members and anyone responsible for getting things done through people, Subject to Evidence offers practical, clear-eyed insight you can use the next time you walk into a room.

New episodes every Monday and Wednesday.

Subject to Evidence is a podcast by Lantern (lanterncorp.com.au), helping organisations strategise with purpose and prove their impact.

Subject to Evidence is made by people and uses some AI working together. Conversations feature both human and AI hosts

title: The Midnight Files
author: Enwongoabasi Ikot
description:
Welcome to The Midnight Files 🌑🎙️

When the world goes quiet and the clock strikes midnight, some stories are better left untold… but we’re going to tell them anyway.

The Midnight Files is a horror and mystery podcast bringing you chilling true stories, unexplained encounters, terrifying experiences, strange disappearances, disturbing mysteries, dark folklore, and fictional tales that will make you question what’s hiding in the shadows.

From encounters that happened in the dead of night to mysteries that have never been solved, each episode takes you deeper into the unknown.

🎧 Put on your headphones. Turn off the lights. Lock the door.

Because once you enter The Midnight Files, you may never look at the darkness the same way again.

Stories Best Heard After Dark. 🌑

title: Manufacturing Skills Australia Podcast

Welcome to the Manufacturing Skills Australia Podcast, where we delve into the heart of the manufacturing industry and explore how education, innovation, and community support are shaping its future. In each episode, we will uncover the multifaceted ways in which Manufacturing Skills Australia is dedicated to enhancing the sector. 

Our mission is to empower individuals by providing opportunities for knowledge development through research, education, and training—all for the benefit of Australia’s manufacturing industry. We're committed to funding and encouraging industry-related study and research through scholarships, endowments, and donations. 

Join us as we discuss innovative research projects, share success stories of Australians who have benefitted from our support, and learn from leaders who are pioneering new advancements. Whether you’re a student, industry professional, or just curious about manufacturing, this podcast will provide valuable insights and inspire action.

description:
Welcome to the show where legacy meets leadership and ambition meets alignment. title: Spring Fire by Vin Packer.
author: AudioBooks
description:
Spring Fire by Vin Packer.  
Spring Fire, is a 1952 paperback novel written by Marijane Meaker, under the pseudonym "Vin Packer". It is the first lesbian paperback novel, and the beginning of the lesbian pulp fiction genre; it also addresses issues of conformity in 1950s American society. The novel tells the story of Susan "Mitch" Mitchell, an awkward, lonely freshman at a Midwestern college who falls in love with Leda, her popular but troubled sorority sister. Published by Gold Medal Books, Spring Fire sold 1.5 million copies through at least three printings.  
Cleis Press re-released the book in 2004 after extensive negotiations with Meaker, who had long denied permission over her feelings about the ending. Following the exposure of their relationship, Leda is committed to a mental institution and Mitch realizes she never loved Leda. Meaker later wrote, "I still cringe when I think about it. I never wanted it republished. It was too embarrassing." Meaker explained in the 2004 foreword that Dick Carroll, her editor at Gold Medal Books, told her that because the book would be sent through the mail, no references to homosexuality as an attractive life could be portrayed or postal inspectors would send it back to the publishing house. He said that one character must acknowledge that she is not a lesbian, and the other she's involved with "must be sick or crazy".  
The story is based on an affair Meaker had in boarding school as a teenager. She was awkward and shy in a new school and fell in love with a more experienced, older girl. They traded love letters, and the other girl's mother found them on the eve of a weekend trip they were to take together. When the girl's mother approached her, "She said she'd rather kill herself than be like me," Meaker remembered.  
She initially wished to title the book Sorority Girl, but her business-minded editor changed the title to Spring Fire in order to confuse potential readers with the James A Michener title The Fires of Spring.

title: What Should You Do When Cyberbullying Happens?
author: Precious Khaiseb
description:
Episode 3: "What Should You Do When Cyberbullying Happens?"
Hi everyone, Today, we're sharing what to do when it happens.


Point one: don't fight back with bullying. Insulting them back only makes things worse and could get you in trouble too. Stay calm and don't reply.


Point two: save evidence. Take screenshots of the messages and posts, and note the dates and usernames. Don't delete anything, because proof helps others act.


Point three: block the bully. This stops them from messaging you or seeing your profile. It's protecting your peace, not running away.


Point four: report the account. Apps and platforms can remove harmful content or suspend the account, so use the report button.


Point five: tell a trusted adult, like a parent, teacher or school counsellor. Asking for help isn't weak. You don't have to face this alone.


Point six: know where to seek help. That could be your school, a social worker, a helpline, or the police if there are threats.


And a special thank you to anyone who has supported a friend going through cyberbullying. Your kindness makes a real difference.


This is the end of our three-episode series on cyberbullying. Stay safe online, be kind, and look out for each other.


Thank you, and goodbye!

Our modality is to critique the work, not the people. We examine each rebrand with a keen eye and an open heart, uncovering the story behind it, decoding the design choices, and asking what they mean for the brand's identity.

From global corporations to local businesses, no rebrand is too big or too small, as long as there's something at stake beyond revenue. Expect candid conversation, expert insight, and a dash of humor, with the goal of modeling positive critique for the design world and every area of life that warrants it.

description:
You got the job. Now comes the part no one fully prepares you for: figuring out how to succeed in it.


Welcome to (Self) Starting a New Job, the podcast that helps you take the driver's seat in your own onboarding and create a more confident, connected, and fulfilling start in your new role.


Your company's new hire training is important, but it can't teach you everything you need to know about navigating workplace relationships, understanding company culture, managing self-doubt, building confidence, and figuring out how to make your mark.


Drawing on nearly 25 years of HR experience, I'll share practical insights, actionable strategies, and a fresh perspective on the mental, professional, and relationship sides of starting a new job. You'll learn how to shift unhelpful thinking, communicate effectively with your manager, build meaningful workplace relationships, clarify expectations, and take intentional steps toward becoming a valued contributor.


Through the Self-Onboarding for Success approach, you'll discover how to move beyond simply getting through your first few months to creating a strong foundation for long-term success, growth, and joy at work.

This isn't about replacing your employer's onboarding program or pretending every workplace is perfect. It's about recognizing what you can control, advocating for what you need, and taking ownership of the experience you're creating for yourself.


Whether you're navigating your first job, changing careers, or starting a new role after years of experience, you'll find practical guidance and resources to help you make the transition with greater clarity, confidence, and purpose.


Your employer hired you. Now it's time to onboard yourself for success.

title: Dark Soul: A Film For The Ears
author: Ros Borland / The Big Light
description:
A little girl in Edinburgh is haunted by a past she doesn’t understand, while her mother battles corrupt cops, patronising doctors and her own fears - to save her.

Dark Soul: A Film for the Ears is an immersive audio adventure aimed at making cinema more accessible for blind and visually impaired people.

Celtic Media Festival Torc Award winner for excellence, supernatural thriller Dark Soul (A film for the Ears) in association with the Royal National Institute of Blind People Scotland, is directed by Zoë Hunter and written by Ros Borland. This is a feature length concept film aimed at making cinema accessible on an equal platform for those who are blind or partially sighted.

Dark Soul is not a conventional film – it is screenplay narrated (not audio described). We recently had a private test screening with an audience made up primarily of visually impaired people – and guide dogs! It worked brilliantly. The feedback from the visually impaired attendees made a powerful case to do more Films for the Ears Event Cinema screenings aka “Dark Screenings”, in order for those who experience sight loss to enjoy the film collectively and be part of a cinema-going community.

title: Child on the Line
author: Natalie Dormer
description:
In 1986, Esther Rantzen went live on BBC television with a promise no one had made before: any child, anywhere in the country, could pick up the phone and be heard. That night, more than 50,000 children tried to call. Forty years on, Childline answers a child every 45 seconds. In Child on the Line, actor and Childline ambassador Natalie Dormer travels to Childline bases across the UK to tell the story of how one woman's refusal to take no for an answer became a lifeline for millions, and to meet the people who keep it going: the volunteer counsellors who answer, the team who fought to build it, and the adults who, as children, made that call. Across three episodes, this documentary series celebrates Childline's 40th anniversary, goes inside a counselling shift, and asks what it will take to protect the next generation in a childhood being rewritten by social media and AI. Made by Dog Rose Productions with the support of the NSPCC. This series contains themes some listeners may find distressing, including child abuse and suicide; support resources are in the show notes. If you're under 19 and need to talk, contact Childline free on 0800 1111 or at
childline.org.uk.

Clinical episodes break down the developments changing how urology is practiced. Built for early-career urologists and the physicians leading their groups.

title: The Golf Feedback Loop Podcast by Total Golf Trainer
author: Total Golf Trainer
description:
Welcome to The Golf Feedback Loop Podcast by Total Golf Trainer where golf instruction, coaching, training, technology, practice and performance come together to help golfers better understand how real improvement actually happens.

Golfers have access to more information than ever before. YouTube tips. Swing videos. Launch monitors. Social media instruction. Training aids. AI swing analysis. Tour-player breakdowns. Yet for many golfers, more information hasn’t necessarily led to better golf.

That’s where the feedback loop begins.

Hosted by the team behind  Total Golf Trainer, the podcast brings together experienced coaches, golf-industry professionals, competitive players, special guests and some of the most interesting minds in the game to have honest conversations about golf improvement, swing instruction, player development, practice habits, training aids, golf technology and performance.

You’ll hear from Michael Gish, owner and inventor of Total Golf Trainer, Fernando Vega, part owner and Head of Media & Marketing, and coach Drew Steckel, along with future guests from across professional golf, coaching, athletics and the golf industry.

The goal isn’t to give you another random swing tip.

It’s to help you better understand the process behind improvement.

We explore questions golfers and coaches deal with every day:

How do you turn a lesson into something you can actually practice?

How do you bridge the gap between what a coach tells you and what your body actually does?

What’s the difference between what a golf swing feels like and what is really happening?

How can feedback create better awareness?

When does technology help — and when does it simply create more information?

Why do so many golfers jump from one swing thought to another without making lasting changes?

What separates great golf coaching from simply reading numbers off a launch monitor?

How should golfers practice when their coach isn’t standing beside them?

And how can training become more structured, measurable and repeatable?

The Golf Feedback Loop goes beyond traditional golf instruction.

We talk PGA Tour and professional golf, elite coaching, amateur improvement, golf swing mechanics, practice systems, player psychology, training aids, launch-monitor technology, golf schools, junior golf, Tour stories, golf media, AI, modern instruction and the changing future of coaching.

Because the lesson is only the beginning.

Most importantly, expect conversations designed to turn information into understanding, understanding into training, and training into performance.

If you’re tired of chasing the next quick fix and ready to better understand your own process, you’re in the right place.

Welcome to The Golf Feedback Loop.

Better Feedback. Better Practice. Better Golf.

Subscribe to the channel and join us for new episodes, golf instruction, coaching conversations, Total Golf Trainer demonstrations, player interviews, Golf School content and more.

description: Sounds for expanding consciousness, heightening awareness, creating positive results using brainwave technology Brainwave Entrainment refers to the brain's electrical response to rhythmic sensory stimulation, such as pulses of sound or light. title: The Zodiac Killer
author: Akbar
description: The Killer Who Turned Murder Into a Puzzle is a three-part true-crime podcast exploring the chilling case of the Zodiac Killer, one of the most notorious unidentified serial killers in American criminal history. Operating primarily in Northern California during the late 1960s, the killer targeted unsuspecting victims, sent threatening letters to newspapers, and challenged authorities to decipher cryptic messages that appeared to contain clues about his identity.This series examines the crimes, the investigation, the coded communications, and the public fascination that transformed the case into a lasting mystery. From the attacks that terrified communities around the San Francisco Bay Area to the infamous ciphers that captured national attention, each episode reveals another layer of a case filled with fear, uncertainty, and unanswered questions.The podcast also explores how the killer used newspapers and public attention to amplify his reputation, why investigators struggled to identify him, and how modern technology continues to inspire new attempts to solve the mystery.Separating documented facts from speculation, this series takes listeners through the evidence, the suspects, and the theories surrounding the case. More than a story about an unidentified killer, it is an examination of an investigation that continues to challenge the boundary between evidence and obsession.

The writers hail from Nottinghamshire and beyond, and live in Nottingham, Derbyshire and across the UK. 

The podcast is the culmination of an intergenerational participation project, working alongside a group of young LGBTQ+ people and their allies from Mansfield and the surrounding area, who undertook a series of skills workshops. Young people used their newly developed skills to interview adult, trans and gender-diverse people of all ages, across Nottinghamshire, capturing their personal lived experiences and stories of identity, moments of resistance as well as joy and community. 

The plays have been directed by Jo Tyabji and with sound design by Louis Blatherwick and Joseff Harris.

The world is full of things we don't fully understand.

title: The Unspoken Motherhood

description:
Real Stories. Difficult Conversations. Breaking the Silence.
Motherhood isn’t always the beautiful story we imagined. Sometimes it’s complicated, heartbreaking, overwhelming, and filled with experiences we rarely talk about.
Welcome to The Unspoken Motherhood, a podcast about the conversations that too often go unheard.
I’m Grace — a wife, a mother, and a woman with a story of my own.
Through personal experiences, candid conversations, and the voices of other women, we’ll explore pregnancy and infant loss, grief, maternal mental health, motherhood expectations, healing, and the difficult subjects society often avoids.
This isn’t about having all the answers. It’s about breaking the silence, challenging expectations, and creating a space where women feel heard, understood, and less alone.
Because every mother has a story. And some of the most important stories are the ones left unspoken.
🌸 Psalm 107:2
“Let the redeemed of the LORD tell their story”
🌷 Ecclesiastes 3:4
“A time to weep and a time to laugh, a time to mourn and a time to dance.”
💜 Proverbs 31:25
“She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come.”

With more than 13 years of experience treating complex cases, Dr. Wu explains how your prescription, age, corneal health, lifestyle, and previous surgeries shape your treatment choices—from LASIK, SMILE Pro, and PRK to EVO ICL and Refractive Lens Exchange (RLE).


Get clear, practical answers about high prescriptions, thin corneas, keratoconus, dry eye, and vision correction after prior surgery. Understand your choices, feel informed, and see what’s possible.

title: The Dark Side of Entrepreneurship
author: Falak
description:
What happens when the dream of becoming your own boss turns into a life you can barely control?

Entrepreneurship is often sold as the ultimate path to freedom, financial independence, and personal success. Social media celebrates luxury offices, expensive cars, overnight success stories, and founders who supposedly never give up. But behind those carefully edited stories lies a side of entrepreneurship that rarely receives the same attention.

Beyond the Hustle explores the uncomfortable realities of building a business. From the loneliness of making decisions nobody else understands to the fear of losing money, the pressure to maintain a successful image, and the exhaustion of working without knowing whether your efforts will pay off, this series takes listeners beyond the motivational speeches.

Across three compelling episodes, we examine the emotional cost of chasing a dream, the financial traps that can turn success into stress, and the dangerous belief that working harder is always the answer.

This is not a podcast designed to discourage ambition. It is a reminder that ambition needs balance, realistic expectations, and a sustainable plan.

If you are an aspiring entrepreneur, a business owner, or simply curious about what happens behind the scenes of success, this series will challenge what you think you know about entrepreneurship.

Because building a business should not mean losing yourself in the process.

description: Empowerment to Living, hosted by John Bellamy, explores life's challenges, personal growth, authenticity, and the pursuit of purpose. Through honest reflections, meaningful stories, and practical insights, we discover how to overcome adversity, embrace who we truly are, and create more fulfilling lives.

title: Kirkbride
author: Comleroy Tavern
description:
Please reflect before proceeding.
Join us in the Comleroy Tavern for our cinematic Dungeons & Dragons podcast set in a dystopian therapeutic utopia, where mystery unfolds slowly, truths are buried carefully, and every choice echoes through memory itself.

In the city of Callan, peace was not found — it was engineered.

Perched atop a marble escarpment, the Kirkbride Institute promises clarity, purpose, and emotional harmony. Through guided reflection, therapeutic programmes, and the Ten Tenets, its citizens are taught that every struggle has meaning… and every misalignment can be corrected.

Memories can be rewritten. Identity can be refined. And anyone, with enough dedication, can become an Exemplar.

But beneath the calm language of wellness lies something far more controlled.

This is a story of a society that doesn’t punish — it corrects.
A system that doesn’t command — it convinces.
And a city where the most dangerous thing you can lose… is yourself.

author: Marie-Eve Lagace
description: La profession enseignante est en constante transformation. Elle subit des changements importants, notamment en raison de l’évolution de la société, de l’avancement de la recherche ainsi qu’en fonction de la manière dont l’éducation est gérée par l’État et de ses décisions. À travers ces transformations, la posture professionnelle enseignante est appelée à s’ajuster, à s’adapter, à se transformer. Et plus que jamais, dans le contexte actuel, notre posture professionnelle doit s’affirmer!  Le colloque Maîtres de notre profession! propose un temps d’arrêt collectif aux enseignantes et enseignants pour les informer, nourrir leur réﬂexion, leur permettre d’échanger et de réseauter, et aussi les consulter.

title: The Daily Muster
author: Edward Parcaut
description:
The Daily Muster is one true story from American history, every single morning, told in about ten minutes.
Each episode lands on the anniversary of the day it happened: the gunfight at the O.K. Corral, the night Martians "landed" on the radio, the pilot shot down over Cuba, the men and women who built, defended and changed this country. Some stories you half remember from school. Most, you never heard at all.
Hosted by Ed Parcaut, a Navy veteran who believes the best stories in American history are the ones most of us never learned, and that fewer kids are hearing them at all. Every episode is researched from primary and trusted sources, listed in the show notes, so you can dig deeper. It's good listening for the drive to work, and for parents and kids who want to learn history together.
New episode every morning at 7:00 a.m. Eastern.
Narrated with an AI clone of the host's own voice, from scripts he approves. The Daily Muster is supported by Parcaut Supply Co.

title: Salt and Shell ©Stella
author: Stella Marie Simmons
description:
Storyteller and Seafood  -  Stella Marie Simmons

From the first scent of a fish market at dawn to the satisfying crackle of a fillet meeting a hot pan, every episode follows the details that make seafood worth understanding. We explore the instincts of experienced fishmongers, the hard-earned knowledge of working fishermen, the science behind crisp skin and tender flesh, and the humble coastal recipes that have sustained families through generations of changing seasons. Along the way, we uncover the history, ingenuity, and sometimes surprising human stories hidden in the everyday life of the shore.

description: Start your morning ahead of the markets. The Daily Ledger is your daily briefing on Canadian and U.S. business and finance: Bay Street and Wall Street, interest rates and mortgages, earnings, energy, tech, and the stories that actually move money. Hosts Alex and Jordan cut through the noise with clear takeaways and a light touch, in about 30 minutes. Built for brokers, investors, and business leaders who want to sound like they read everything, because they listened to this. New episodes every morning.

Everyday Jacket is an independent fan podcast about My Morning Jacket, the music we love, and the people and experiences that come with it.

Guests include Larry Charles (Seinfeld, Borat), manager Barry Katz, comedy teacher Judy Carter, and comedians from New York, Los Angeles, Vancouver, Brazil and from all across the globe!

title: After Dark with Christine
author: CMPWritesBooks
description: Welcome to After Dark with Christine, a cozy, conversational podcast where everyday life, creativity, memories, strange stories, family traditions, writing, and a little bit of the unexpected all come together. I’m Christine, author and founder of CMPWritesBooks, and I’m inviting you along for the ride as I write, publish, build my business, develop new creative projects, and share the stories and experiences that inspire me along the way. But I don’t want this journey to be one-sided. I want to hear from you, too. Through emails, listener stories, questions, memories, and conversations, I hope this becomes a place where we can share a little of our lives with one another.Some nights we may talk about writing and where story ideas come from. Other nights it might be holidays, childhood memories, spooky legends, family traditions, creative adventures, or simply something that’s been on my mind. A little bit of this. A little bit of that. A little CMPWritesBooks — and plenty of real life in between. So settle in, get comfortable, and come along for the ride. Let’s get the conversation started.

title: VIBE Okanagan
author: VIBE Okanagan
description:
The VIBE Okanagan Podcast brings you the people, stories, ideas and experiences that make the Okanagan one of the most incredible places to live, work, visit and explore.

From local entrepreneurs, artists, chefs, winemakers and creators to community leaders, candidates and the characters who shape life in the Valley, each episode goes beyond the usual tourism story.

Hosted by Ray Brown, CEO and Editor-in-Chief of VIBE Okanagan, the podcast explores the people behind the places, the stories behind the businesses, the conversations shaping our communities, and the VIBE behind the Okanagan.

Whether you live here, are planning your next visit, or simply love discovering great people and great stories, this is the Okanagan, through a different lens.

description:
Real animals. Secret superpowers. In every episode of Animal Power Showdown, five real animals step onto the stage to show off an amazing power: sharks that sense hidden electricity, dinosaurs with spiky crowns, sea creatures that change color in a flash. Made for curious kids ages 6 to 10, and the grown-ups listening along. Every episode ends with a "Your Turn" question to talk about together.

title: The Power of Where Podcast
author: The Power of Where
description:
For decades, marketing fundamentals have been about the 4Ps: product, price, promotion and perhaps the most often overlooked: place.
The Power of Where is a future focused podcast exploring how place shapes perception, emotion, behaviour and growth, hosted by Blackjet CEO Robert Galletta.
From hospitality and retail to entertainment and travel, environments build trust, create belonging, influence decisions and turn experiences into lasting memories.
Each episode examines where culture is moving, where consumers are heading and how brands can use place as a strategic advantage to drive value.

title: The American Upside

description: We are both self made multi millionaires who "did it" in Canada. We made it! But we quickly realized the juice wasn't worth the squeeze to stay in Canada. 54% taxes, high regulations slowing us down and an economy that's just failing! Welcome to Love Well 🤍
Love well is a space for real life, raw stories, and the redemptive love of Jesus. Here, we embrace the messy, beautiful, and broken parts of life, inviting Jesus into every chapter, every struggle, and every new beginning. A place where immense love meets abundant grace, shame loses its grip, and truth is spoken with tenderness. No perfect people. No polished stories. Just real life, an ever-present Savior, and the beautiful reminder that grace has the final word. 
Come as you are. Be met with love. Leave changed by grace 💛

title: Voices from the Generals
author: Voices from the Generals
description:
"Voices from the Generals” is a podcast that aims to support the transition to college with episodes featuring specific themes regarding students’ college experiences. Hosted by Washington and Lee University students, the podcast seeks to bring out the real voice and insights of students, faculty, and staff to the audience. The transition to higher education is often experienced as a challenging and uncertain journey, regardless of one’s background or abilities. Whether you are a current undergraduate or a prospective student, we are here to guide you through the journey.

title: Lara Lewington's Your Body of Evidence
author: Joy Peddlers
description:
What secrets can your body’s data reveal about your health?

In Your Body of Evidence, technology journalist and broadcaster Lara Lewington explores the science behind health data, wearable technology, at-home testing and the latest wellness claims.

From sleep tracking and personalised nutrition to weight-loss drugs and ageing, each episode asks what the research really shows, which tools and tests are worth using, and how to make sense of the results.

Lara is joined by leading experts to explore how to make more informed decisions about health and support a longer healthspan: more years spent feeling well, active and free from disease.

Produced by Joy Peddlers Studios in partnership with Thriva, Your Body of Evidence is a health podcast that helps listeners cut through the noise and understand what’s worth doing, and what isn’t.

title: And, Tell Me More About That
author: Dr Iain Bolton, Dr Seb Pillon
description:
There’s a lot of health advice out there. How do you know what to believe?
In And, Tell Me More About That, Dr Iain Bolton and Dr Seb Pillon discuss the health stories making headlines, the trends taking over social media and the questions that come up in everyday GP practice.
Drawing on medical evidence and their own experiences, they explore what’s useful, what’s overhyped and what we still don’t know. 
For anyone curious about health, whether you work in medicine or not. New episodes every week.

title: Talk Like A Local: Italian

description: Ciao a tutti, and welcome! I’m a Canadian girl with a passion for languages, especially the romance languages. After spending five months living in Naples, in Chiaia, while studying structural engineering, I fell in love with Italy and the Italian language. This podcast is for anyone who wants to learn Italian in a natural, fun, and approachable way through culture, conversation, and everyday expressions. Whether you’re a beginner or already learning, I’m so happy you’re here. Benvenuti!

title: Growing Loud
author: Children in Scotland
description:
Growing Loud is the podcast from Children in Scotland exploring the issues shaping childhood today. Hosted by Innes Burns, each episode features conversations with young people, parents, practitioners, campaigners and sector leaders working to improve the lives of children and families across Scotland.
From children's mental health, education and child poverty to youth voice, parenting, public health and children's rights, Growing Loud takes a closer look at the challenges facing young people and the ideas helping them thrive.

title: Katie and Erik | Life After Betrayal
author: Katie and Erik
description:
Infidelity can shatter a marriage, destroy trust, and leave both partners asking questions they never imagined facing. But what does healing actually look like?
Through our personal story of betrayal and recovery, honest conversations about marriage, and insights into faith, counseling, and mental health, we explore why affairs happen, how couples navigate the aftermath, and what it takes to rebuild trust.
Whether you're the betrayed spouse, the partner who was unfaithful, or someone trying to help a couple you love, this podcast offers honest conversations about affair recovery, forgiveness

description: Welcome to the Shit Spinners Podcast! We spin some shit in the form of real conversation based on a randomly drawn topic from an actual jar, yes, an actual real-life jar. We challenge ourselves with every podcast to never back down from a topic drawn and the best part is: we are just spinning the shit and having fun while doing it. So come have fun with us!

Hosted by Professor Profanity, a nurse educator with over 20 years of clinical experience, we're making complicated medical concepts make sense through humor, sarcasm, hilarious analogies, and real-world examples.
From pharmacology and pathophysiology to cardiac rhythms and beyond, we're here to help you understand the WHY, not just memorize the WHAT.
Around here, we don't just memorize, we conceptualize.

description:
Real estate magic with The Moonlit Agent.
I'm Jessa Clark, a Georgia realtor who plans by the moon and uses intuition, systems, magic, and logic to make it happen.
For many of us, becoming an agent is a spiritual awakening. This is a gentle space for agents to explore rituals, moon-timed planning, and the systems that hold a grounded business together, rooted in Mind, Body, Spirit, and Systems.
New episodes follow the moon.

title: The Staple Podcast
author: Kim Kombat | Kut Sotor
description:
THE STAPLE PODCAST | EPISODE 1
Hosted by Kim Kombat | Co-Host: Kut Sotor
Today's Social Climate — The Reality of People
Has society changed, or are we finally seeing people for who they really are?
In the debut episode of The Staple Podcast, host Kim Kombat and co-host Kut Sotor explore today's social climate and the realities of human behavior.
From loyalty, relationships, and respect to accountability, social media influences, and the way we treat one another, this episode takes a closer look at the issues shaping our everyday lives.

title: Go Now with Dr. Kris Halsey
author: Dr. Kris Halsey
description:
Welcome to Go Now with Dr. Kris Halsey. I am Dr. Halsey, pastor, life coach, and
mental health and wellness practitioner. For years I watched good people postpone
their dreams, waiting for the perfect moment, the perfect time, the perfect sign.
But grief taught me what comfort never could: tomorrow is not promised. On this
podcast we have honest conversations about faith, purpose, and going after the
life you were made for. We will name the dream, face the wait, ask for wisdom,
take the step, and declare it. Not someday, but Today. Subscribe now, and let's 
Go now.

title: Dying of Embarrassment
author: Throne Science
description:
Dying of Embarrassment is a Health & Wellness podcast about the awkward, avoided, and unspoken conversations that quietly shape our health—and sometimes save our lives.

The podcast is hosted by Scott Hickle, Co-Founder and CEO of Throne, and each episode addresses the stuff most of us keep to ourselves—the bodily quirks, the doctor’s-office dread, the “is this normal?” questions you’d never Google on a shared computer. From gut health to grief, from the doctor’s office to the dinner table, we dig into the subjects buried under stigma and treat them like what they are: a normal, important part of being human.

Scott founded Throne to bring passive, clinically meaningful health data into the home, and he started Dying of Embarrassment from the same belief: the conversations we avoid about our bodies, health, and lives are usually the ones that matter most. Because avoiding these conversations almost always costs us more than the embarrassment of having them.

Learn more at http://dyingofembarrassment.com/

title: Alone in NY
author: An Introvert
description: A solo introvert navigating life, heavy thoughts, and quiet isolation inside the crowded streets of New York City. No small talk, just honest late night reflections.

title: Tin tức
author: Redhai
description: Tin tức

title: Looking Ahead
author: Anna Lunde
description:
As AI transforms industries, some leaders are already thinking several steps ahead. And those are the people I want to speak with.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: Hey God It’s Me...Talk With God Through Music
author: Kathryn Romanchuk
description:
HEY GOD…IT’S ME;Talk With God Through Music is a Christian podcast for when your heart is FULL, your Faith is being tested, & you can’t quite find the words to pray.

Want to hear the prayer sung and sing it with me? Head over to my YouTube channel and choose the Hey God… It’s Me... Let’s turn the music into a prayer together. https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLMwgXeE2jRFk. 💜

What do you say to God when you don’t know what to say? 

Sometimes you’re anxious, exhausted, lonely, angry or afraid, sometimes you’re grieving.. Sometimes you’re incredibly grateful. And sometimes all you can manage is, Hey God…it’s me. Talk to God Through...That’s where the music comes in. 🎶

Each podcast is the prelude to a song, a lyric, a feeling or a real-life moment and turns it into a conversation with God. Together, we’ll use music as a starting point for Prayer, Scripture, reflection and an honest relationship with Jesus—because prayer doesn’t have to sound perfect to be heard.

This isn’t about having all the answers or knowing exactly what to say. It’s about showing up exactly where you are and learning that sometimes the song playing in your head might just help you say what’s already sitting in your heart.

If you’ve ever whispered, cried, sung or simply thought, “God, I need You”… this podcast is for you.

🎧 Press play. Listen to these words. Head over to HEY GOD…IT’S ME Talk With God Through Music. Then talk to God again.

Hey God… It’s ME. 💜

title: The Soft Power Rising
author: Anna
description:
I'm Anna. For most of my life, I was the woman who could do it all. And I took enormous pride in that. 

But somewhere along the way, I'd become so good at being everything everyone needed me to be that I'd forgotten to ask myself what I needed. 

For me, it was motherhood that made that impossible to ignore. And what started as a difficult period in my life ended up making me question everything I'd believed about myself. 

The Soft Power Rising is the story of what happened when I finally decided I was worth showing up for, too. 

I'm still figuring things out. But I'm no longer willing to lose myself in the process.

title: Two Minute Papers
author: Two Minute Papers
description:
Two Minute Papers explains the latest research papers in artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer graphics and simulation in short, accessible episodes. Each episode walks through what a new paper achieves, how it works, and why it matters. What a time to be alive!

Links:
Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/TwoMinutePapers

title: Walking Feet, Leaping Thoughts
author: K.Kawashima
description:
Kyoto is more than temples and historic streets. Beneath the city lies a landscape shaped by fault lines, ancient rocks, rivers, forgotten roads, place names, and thousands of years of geological and cultural memory.
This podcast begins with walking. Each episode starts from something noticed underfoot—a change in the terrain, an unexpected view, or a place that feels strangely different. From those physical encounters, the journey expands into geology, folklore, history, sociology, and philosophy.
Keywords: Kyoto , Japan , travel , culture , geology , folklore , philosophy

title: Did You Hear What Happened at Work?
author: Stefanie Costi
description:
You know those work horror stories people whisper about in the kitchen?
The ones that start with, “Did YOU hear what happened?” and suddenly everyone stops pretending to make coffee.
Someone checks the door. Someone lowers their voice. And then the room goes quiet because everyone knows it is about to get ugly. 
Well, we’re DONE whispering.
Introducing our brand new podcast, Did You Hear What Happened at Work? 🎙️
We’re bringing you REAL people sharing their experiences of the WILD things people think they can get away with at work.

title: The Overlook
author: Dally Munoz
description: Welcome to The Overlook, the podcast where we dive deep into the world of life simulation games. Join us as we explore the intersection of deep, character-driven gameplay—inspired by the memorable quirks and neighborhood gossip of classic titles—and expansive open worlds. Whether we're dissecting independent projects like SimGoodie, discussing the evolution of building and automation mechanics, or tracking what makes a virtual neighborhood feel truly alive, this is your scenic viewpoint for all things life sims. Pull up a bench, look out over the bay, and join the conversation!

title: Quake's House
author: All Things Comedy
description: Quake’s House is back. Legendary comedian Earthquake brings his signature humor, quick wit, and unfiltered perspective to the table in conversations built around comedy, storytelling, and uncensored opinions. Each week, Quake is joined by friends, fellow comedians, and other guests to joke, roast, debate, and talk about everything from relationships and sports to pop culture, current events, and everyday life. Nothing is off limits, and no one is safe from the punchline.Expect hilarious stories, strong opinions, unexpected debates, and the kind of unfiltered conversations you can only have at Quake’s House. No scripts. No holding back. Just great conversation and even better laughs. Pull up a chair. You’re home.

title: All Things: Word and Spirit
author: @AllThingsWordandSpirit
description: Jesus said that God the Father sent the Holy Spirit to Believers to teach us ALL things! It is by the power of the Holy Spirit and the truth of the Word that we live victorious lives, triumphing over every obstacle.

title: Aggregate Society
author: Andre Woodard and Trevon McGlone
description: Ag Society is a podcast where two fans of the game of football talk about all things Champions League Soccer….probably casually, but still for the love of the game.

title: The Impossible Interview with Sam
author: Sergio AM
description:
History’s legends, back for one more chat.
Each episode, Sam summons a famous figure from the past with a ritual inspired by their life. Inventors, queens, conquerors and rebels correct the myths, share the stories textbooks skip, and imagine “what if” they had made one different choice. Funny, light and grounded in real history.
Sam’s voice is an AI clone of the creator’s own voice; all guest voices are AI-generated, and the interviews are imagined. The history is real; the jokes are not.

title: Inspired by Design with Sarah St Pierre
author: Sarah St Pierre
description: Pour your favorite drink and pull up a seat. This podcast is about real life, becoming who you’re meant to be, and creating a life that actually feels good to live in. We talk about mindset, personal growth, wellness, ambition, and the raw, honest conversations that help you feel clearer, more confident, and more connected to yourself. Some episodes feel like a pep talk. Others feel like a conversation you didn’t know you needed. Through solo episodes and honest conversations with inspiring women, you’ll find encouragement, clarity, perspective, and the reminder that you’re not alone in what you’re navigating. Think of this as a FaceTime call with your big sister. Here to hype you up, ground you, and remind you that you’re allowed to want more and enjoy your life along the way.

title: Belonging in Public Health
author: Faculty of Public Health
description:
Belonging in Public Health is a new podcast series from the UK Faculty of Public Health (FPH), the Royal Society for Public Health (RSPH), the UK Public Health Register (UKPHR) and the London Association of Directors of Public Health (ADPH London). In each episode, a public health professional talks openly about how their identity has shaped their career and what belonging in public health means to them.
The series is hosted by Samia Latif, FPH Board Member and Chair of the Faculty's Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Committee, and Matthew Bazeley-Bell, Deputy Chief Executive of RSPH.

title: Synapse & Scalpel
author: Dina Abou Dargham
description: Step into the intricate intersection of medicine, neuropsychology, and fascinating human history. Hosted by Dina Abou Dargham, Synapse & Scalpel explores the hidden biological mechanisms, brain quirks, and medical mysteries that shape our minds and bodies. Tune in for quick, deep dives into the science of what makes us human.

title: ACMA Medical Affairs x MSL Power Play Series
author: Will Soliman, PhD
description: Leveling up in Medical Affairs or as an MSL? The ACMA Medical Affairs x MSL Power Play Series gives you the insider playbook. ACMA founder Will Soliman sits down with Medical Science Liaisons and pharma leaders from Novo Nordisk, Roche, Lundbeck, and others to share what it really takes to excel and thrive in medical affairs and field medical. Learn the MSL trends reshaping the role, how metrics drive your success, how to handle tough managers, and how to grow your career. Plus HEOR and life sciences career strategy from the makers of the BCMAS. Follow now and start with Episode 1.

title: George Podcast
author: George Martin
description: George's Podcast brings you exciting insights into the world of technology, artificial intelligence, smart gadgets, and digital innovation. Join George for engaging discussions, fresh tech trends, and practical tips that make modern technology easy to understand and enjoyable for everyone.

title: The Economics Of It
author: Cato Institute
description:
If it's making headlines, there's economics behind it.


Every Thursday on The Economics of It, Cato's Ryan Bourne sits down with leading thinkers to dig into the hidden economics of today's biggest debates, from rent control and tariffs to AI and the cost of war.


Who benefits? Who pays? What happens next? Subscribe and find out.

Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

title: The Irrelevant Leader
author: Phil Jewell | Adam Piercy
description:
What if the best thing you could do as a leader was to make yourself irrelevant?


Not invisible. Not unnecessary. Just no longer the bottleneck.


Join co-hosts Adam Piercy and Phil Jewell, author of The Irrelevant Leader, military veteran, and executive leadership coach, for honest, thought-provoking conversations about what it really takes to lead people well.


Adam asks the questions, challenges the thinking, and draws out the stories and lessons from Phil's experiences in the military, business, and beyond.


Together, they explore the behaviours that hold leaders and their teams back, challenging conventional thinking around trust, delegation, decision-making, accountability, and letting go of control.


Expect candid conversations, practical insights, and a different perspective on what great leadership actually looks like.


Because great leadership isn't about being at the centre of everything. It's about building a team that succeeds without you having to be.

title: The Pregnant Pastor
author: Danielle Phifer Singletary
description:
Behind the pulpit is a woman. Behind the title is a story.
Welcome to The Pregnant Pastor, hosted by Rev. Danielle Phifer Singletary. Through honest, personal storytelling, Danielle shares the beautiful, exhausting, and unexpected realities of pregnancy, postpartum, motherhood, marriage, faith, and ministry.
This podcast is about more than pregnancy. It's for every woman learning to care for herself while showing up for everyone else.
Real stories. Real life. Real faith. Because being called doesn't mean having it all together.

title: The Buddha's Path
author: Jupiter Asar
description:
The Buddha’s Path is a journey into manifestation, universal laws, spiritual wisdom, self-mastery, and the power of cleansing the body, mind, and spirit. Each episode explores ancient wisdom and practical spiritual principles that can help you understand your energy, strengthen your consciousness, and intentionally create the life you desire.
We explore the Law of Attraction, universal laws, fasting and cleansing, meditation, manifestation, discipline, relationships, nature, ancestral wisdom, abundance, and the deeper connection between your inner world and the reality you experience. Tap in!

title: Late Night with Seth Meyers
author: Seth Meyers
description: Seth Meyers hosts NBC’s “Late Night,” home to A Closer Look, Day Drinking, and more!

title: The Sunday Nugget With Jeff Case
author: Jeffery
description: The Sunday Nugget with Jeff Case shares a Bible scripture, a brief heartfelt message, and a Christian song to bring hope and encouragement to your week. Created as a way for Jeff to cope with the passing of his son and honor his memory, the show offers a moment to reflect, find comfort in God’s Word, and grow in faith. Hosted by Jeff Case and brought to life with executive producer Sundee Hancock, each episode offers a little nugget of hope to carry with you.

title: Priestly Daily Blessings
author: Bishop Johnson Ejomah
description: Daily blessings by Bishop Johnson Ejomah, Sr. Pastor of Bethesda Community Church of Antioch, CA.

title: Love on Location
author: Love on Location
description: We're tired of looking for love online, so we're ditching the dating apps and going to the places where people actually hang out and meet in real life. Every episode, we're somewhere new: a rock climbing gym, a dive bar, a bookshop. We're figuring out the vibe, meeting new people, and reporting back with everything you need to know about the best places to meet people, navigate the NYC dating scene, and maybe meet your future partner in the wild. Join us as we discover where to find Love on Location.

title: Kill the commute
author: Kill the commute
description:
Welcome to Kill the Commute.
If you're staring down a long drive, a grueling shift, or just trying to find something for the weekend, you're in the right place. I just give you the straight verdicts so you don't waste your downtime.
Audiobooks, Games, TV, & Film.
No fluff, no wasted time. Hit subscribe, drive safe, and catch you on the next one.

title: Her Kind of Business
author: Karen Dennett
description:
Want to make a difference and good money from your business and still have time and energy left for everything else in your life?


Join business mentor, educator, author and entrepreneur Karen Dennett on Her Kind of Business for honest conversations about finding customers, making money and running a business without letting it run you.


Karen breaks business down into practical, bite-sized ideas you can put into action, without the pressure to hustle harder, grow a team or build someone else's version of success.


Expect practical advice and real conversations about money, marketing, customers, boundaries, confidence and what it takes to run a small business alongside relationships, family and life.


If you're a woman building a small, micro or home-based business, Her Kind of Business will help you make better business decisions and build a business that works for you.

title: Beyond the Cap
author: Cutberto Hernandez
description:
Beyond the Cap: Architecting Legacy Beyond the Arena is a podcast hosted by Cubie Hernandez, a former NCAA water polo player, Mexican National Team athlete, and top 1% mortgage professional in Southern California.
Every athlete knows what it feels like to compete at the highest level. But what happens when the final whistle blows? This show explores the untold stories of former athletes and how the discipline, resilience, and mindset forged in sport carried them into their careers, businesses, and communities.
Each episode is a relaxed 20-minute conversation covering your athletic journey, the transition out of sport, and where life has taken you since. Episodes publish on Spotify, Apple Podcasts, and Amazon Music.
Whether you played in high school, competed at the NCAA level, or represented your country on the national stage, your story belongs here.
Beyond the Cap is proudly rooted in the LMU water polo community and built for athletes everywhere.

Talk-heavy rockets, launches and orbital mechanics plus weekly space news. · Niche: spaceflight & rocketry

title: Most Likely to Teen Movie
author: Eric Marlin, C. Meaks Meaker, Luke Daniel White
description:
School is in session! Three queer theatermakers watch, analyze, and celebrate the beloved and expansive realm of teen cinema. Featuring dramaturgical questions, nominating senior superlatives, and many notes passed in class. Have fun in high school for the first time with Most Likely to Teen Movie! 


Visit our website mostlikelytoteenmovie.com, or follow us on Instagram @mostlikelytoteenmovie.

title: soapdish love
author: Kevin + Mary Kate Losleben
description: hey, we're Kevin and Mary Kate Losleben. we've been married 15 years, have 10 kids, homeschool, and somehow still like each other. so come and join us in our sleep-deprived, coffee-fueled ramblings as we discuss marriage, parenting, and following Jesus, all from a Catholic perspective.

title: After the Demo
author: John Arndt
description: Practical conversations about AI and what it can actually do in your business.

title: Anomalous Files
author: Anomalous Files
description: Welcome to the outer edges of the official record. We investigate the stories the mainstream narrative leaves behind—from cold-case true crime and institutional cover-ups to deep-sea anomalies and phenomena that defy explanation. If there's a file buried, a timeline that doesn't add up, or a truth hiding right in plain sight, we're digging it up. No filters, no corporate guidelines, just the deep-dive rabbit holes you’ve been looking for. New episodes drop weekly

title: Side Quest: Life
author: Pearlwitch
description:
Side Quest: Life is a podcast about gaming, nostalgia, adulthood and finding your way back to the things that make you feel like you.
Hosted by Pearlwitch, expect stories about growing up with games, rediscovering gaming as an adult, trying streaming and content creation, family life, getting older, and all the random side quests that happen along the way.
It won't always be polished, and I definitely don't have everything figured out — but that's part of the adventure.
If you love gaming, are starting something new later in life, or you're simply trying to find a little more time for yours

title: Business Advice from Walter White
author: Apollos
description: As Mr. White dives into his experience of business endeavors, I couldn’t help but notice his drive as well as team spirit. From the inner city of Milwaukee, he dives into his journey.

title: Natural Remedies for Good Health
author: 3ABN
description:
What natural approaches can help us make healthier choices and support the 
body’s healing process? On Natural Remedies for Good Health, Linda and Eddie 
Clark explore nutrition, herbs, juicing, cleansing, fasting, supplementation, and 
the eight laws of health. Addressing common health concerns, they share 
practical information while emphasizing prayer, Scripture, and trusting God as the 
Great Physician.

title: Backyard Reno
author: Lee LaMarche
description: Arkansas homeowner Dan Williams records diaries of his long backyard landscaping renovation.  The project begins to get worse as things go wrong, pieces go over budget, and things are being dug up that shouldn’t be, with grave consequences.  Follow Dan on his renovation journey!

title: T_SHE_PANG Vol. 1
author: T_SHE_PANG
description:
Amapiano, but from the heart.
T_SHE_PANG VOL. 1 is more than a mixtape, it's a statement. Straight out the stairs, straight from the soul. Raw stories, late nights, survival and ambition. No filter, nothing. Just T_SHE_PANG in his purest form.
This is Chapter 1. The beginning of a legacy.
Executive mixed and compiled by T_SHE_PANG.


Please share, like and repost.

title: The London Church
author: London International Christian Church
description:
Not your average church. Not your average Sunday.

Welcome to the official sermon podcast of the London International Christian Church. Listen to powerful biblical teaching from our services across London, designed to strengthen your faith and challenge you to grow.

One church. One mission. One generation.

title: The Real Intelligence Podcast
author: Gary Kadi
description:
If your business stops the moment you step away, this show is for you.
The Real Intelligence Podcast is about how we work and live in the new AI world, hosted by Gary Kadi and Gus Waite. It is for business owners and C-suite executives who are ready to stop being the bottleneck in their own business.
Season one, Inside Man, asked what success was costing the man behind it. Season two goes outside and asks the harder question: how do you redesign a business so that success no longer requires the owner, the team or the family to suffer?
Gary and Gus build the answer in public. Every episode is what they are actually installing, inside delegAIte and inside the businesses they work with. What worked, what did not, and what it cost to find out. Real systems, real stories, no theory.
Gary Kadi has spent more than 30 years coaching business owners and has worked with more than 6,000 businesses. He founded NextLevel Practice, created the category of Complete Health Dentistry, and built and sold his own company in a triple-win exit.
Gus Waite is Chief of AI Innovation and Integration at delegAIte, and runs delegAIte itself as the proof: an agentic company with no employees, where everything that repeats is handled by systems and the people do only what they love.
What we cover: agentic AI inside a real business, the Eight Divisions, scaling without adding headcount, getting the owner out of the operating seat, what to automate first and what to leave alone, and the beliefs that have to move before any of it works.
Recent conversations include building the first FDA-cleared skin cancer scanner for family doctors, and what it takes to run a five million dollar company with no employees at all.
Book a call: delegaite.co
Nobody gets replaced. Everybody gets elevated.

title: The Prince of India (Why Constantinople Fell)
author: Lew Wallace
description:
The Wandering Shoemaker, a figure cursed to roam the earth until the Second Coming, witnesses the rise and fall of empires in Lew Wallace's captivating novel, *The Prince of India; or Why Constantinople Fell*. Journey through history as this intriguing character navigates the complexities of faith, power, and redemption across centuries. From the crucifixion of Jesus to the pivotal moments leading to the fall of Constantinople, each chapter reveals layers of conflict that challenge his understanding of humanity and divine purpose.

As he encounters historical figures and witnesses monumental events, the shoemaker wrestles with his own identity and the weight of his curse. Is he merely a spectator, or does his existence hold the key to a greater truth? The intertwining of legend and history creates a rich tapestry that explores themes of sacrifice, love, and the eternal struggle between good and evil.

Listeners will be drawn into a world where every choice has consequences, and the paths of destiny collide in unexpected ways. With each twist and turn, *The Prince of India* invites you to ponder the profound questions of life and faith while keeping you on the edge of your seat. Don't miss this opportunity to experience a unique blend of folklore and historical fiction that redefines the boundaries of storytelling.

title: The Decoding Clicks and Cashflow Podcast
author: decodingclicksandcashflow
description:
Most founders aren't losing because they're not spending enough on
marketing they're losing because they don't know what's working.

Decoding Clicks and Cash Flow is the no-fluff podcast for businesses
ready to stop guessing and start scaling. Guests range from high-ticket
founders and premium service operators sharing what moved the needle
in their business. Elite practitioners, thought leaders, and influential voices
across sales, growth, and marketing deliver the kind of straight talk that
used to be reserved for the highest-paying clients in the room.

Every guest brings hard-won, real-world insight no theory, no agency
jargon, just straight talk from the people who've built it. Tune in to find out
exactly where to focus, what to cut, and how to build a system that turns
clicks into consistent cash flow.

title: OSU Update from Oklahoma's Own
author: Griffin Media
description: Stay connected to Oklahoma State athletics with the OSU Update.  Featuring the latest news, interviews, analysis and opinions from John Holcomb and the Oklahoma’s Own Sports team. OSU Update keeps you up to speed on what’s happening in Stillwater....from breaking news and press conferences to game previews, recaps and conversations surrounding the Cowboys. Episodes every Tuesday and Friday.

title: Tangent Mode
author: Delante Ridley
description:
Welcome to **Tangent Mode**, where movies and TV shows take center stage, but the conversation can go anywhere! From honest reviews, wild fan theories, and unpopular opinions to hilarious hot takes, pop culture, and everyday life, nothing is off the table. One minute we're breaking down the latest blockbuster, the next we're questioning something completely random. No scripts, no sugarcoating, just one guy, a microphone, and a million different thoughts.
**Tangent Mode — Anything. Everything. And Everything In Between.**
